name: Bergen Fall 2025
information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Bergen Fall. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### Nye Deltakere
Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese  [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2025#63474-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to to Bergen Fall! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete.

### New Competitors
There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2025#63474-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.
